name: can-atlas
description: CAN DBC workbench: outline, hover, problems, frame decode and encode, bit layout. Pro: DBC diff, trace decode, statistics, documentation. Works offline; only the licence check uses the network.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Decoding a trace file streams it from the local disk; in a virtual workspace a trace is read whole and is limited to 64 MB. Every other feature works in virtual workspaces.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Open a DBC file to see its messages, signals, nodes and value tables here.
[Open Sample DBC](command:canAtlas.openSample)
[Open Sample DBC With Problems](command:canAtlas.openSampleProblems)
[Getting Started Guide](command:canAtlas.openWalkthrough)

Compare two versions of a DBC file (Pro, included in the free 14-day trial). Every change is listed as breaking, non-breaking or cosmetic.
[Compare DBC With Another File](command:canAtlas.compareFiles)

walkthroughs.title: Get started with CAN Atlas
walkthroughs.description: Open a sample DBC file, read signals in a hover, find problems with their codes, decode and encode a frame and try the Pro tools in the free 14-day trial.

steps.title: Open a sample DBC file
steps.description:
CAN Atlas reads DBC files, the text format of CAN databases. Open the invented sample to follow along, or open one of your own files.
[Open Sample DBC](command:canAtlas.openSample)

steps.title: Read the outline and hover a signal
steps.description:
The CAN Atlas view lists the messages with their signals, the nodes and the value tables. Rest the pointer on a signal to see its bits, byte order, scaling, unit, receivers and value descriptions.
[Show the Outline](command:workbench.view.extension.canAtlas)

steps.title: Find problems
steps.description:
Open the sample with problems: an overlap, a signal beyond the data length, a misspelt receiver, an inverted range, a duplicate ID and a missing extended-frame flag appear in the Problems view, each with a code.
[Open Sample DBC With Problems](command:canAtlas.openSampleProblems)
[Check Current File](command:canAtlas.checkFile)

steps.title: Decode and encode a frame
steps.description:
Enter an ID and the data bytes of a frame and see every signal's raw and physical value, or enter physical values and get the bytes. Show Bit Layout draws the byte and bit grid of a message.
[Decode Frame](command:canAtlas.decodeFrame)
[Encode Signals](command:canAtlas.encodeSignals)
[Show Bit Layout](command:canAtlas.showBitLayout)

steps.title: Try the Pro tools (14-day trial)
steps.description:
Decode a whole trace file with a DBC, compare two versions of a DBC, draw the bit layout, or write documentation. The first Pro command starts a free 14-day trial on this computer; no key, account or network is needed.
[Open Sample Trace](command:canAtlas.openSampleTrace)
[Decode Trace With This DBC](command:canAtlas.decodeTrace)
[Show Licence Status](command:canAtlas.licenceStatus)

canAtlas.maxFileSizeMB.markdownDescription: Largest file, in megabytes, that is checked automatically and gets hovers, the outline and symbols. Larger files are checked on demand with **CAN Atlas: Check Current File**.

canAtlas.maxProblems.markdownDescription: Largest number of problems listed per file.

canAtlas.validateOnType.markdownDescription: Check DBC files while you type (after a short pause). Files above 2 MB are checked when opened and saved.

canAtlas.hover.enabled.markdownDescription: Show bits, byte order, scaling, unit, receivers and value descriptions when the pointer rests on a signal, a message, a node or a value table.

canAtlas.problems.disabledCodes.markdownDescription: Codes of problems that are not reported, for example `DBC-SIGNAL-NO-RECEIVER` or `DBC-NAME-LONG`. The codes are listed in the documentation.

canAtlas.workspace.include.markdownDescription: Glob pattern of the files that **Create Workspace DBC Inventory** (Pro) reads.

canAtlas.workspace.exclude.markdownDescription: Glob pattern of files and folders that the workspace inventory skips.

canAtlas.workspace.maxFiles.markdownDescription: Largest number of DBC files the workspace inventory reads.

canAtlas.trace.maxTableRows.markdownDescription: Largest number of decoded rows that **Decode Trace With This DBC** (Pro) keeps for the table. Statistics and exports always cover the whole trace; the table shows the first rows that match the filter.

canAtlas.export.neutraliseFormulas.markdownDescription: In CSV exports (Pro), put an apostrophe before every cell that starts with `=`, `+`, `-`, `@`, a tab or a carriage return, so that a spreadsheet shows it as text instead of running it as a formula. Plain numbers such as `-12.5` are left alone. Turn off only when you need the exact values and open the files in a program that does not run formulas.
